title: Section 7.4 support radius vs object size
subtitle: Disk support, bars and disks, $d = 3$, normalize_coords = True, clean binary stimulus

config.apparatus_reduction: Metrics are measured from a centered local patch rather than the full 1024^2 frame because the feature is isolated and the largest support radius is 128 px; the patch fully contains the feature and every neighborhood that can influence the central measurement window.
